page.title: Dashboard
page.purpose: Give operators a dense first view of provider health, route activity, policy gaps, and AI conformance debt so they can decide what needs attention.

priorities.statement: Show whether local and hosted provider paths are usable right now.
Surface recent routing failures and policy gaps before routine success details.
Make unresolved conformance findings visible without turning the dashboard into a report page.

states.description: Provider, route evidence, conformance, and policy summaries are visible.
One or more dashboard queries are still resolving.
One or more operator APIs failed and the dashboard surfaces the error without blanking the page.
No route evidence or conformance findings have been returned yet.

claims.statement: The dashboard exposes a named operator region as the first screen.
